d: Picture yourself brightening someone’s day. When you join our Hotels team, that’s exactly what you’ll do every time you come to work! As a Guest Services Executive, you’re not just ensuring a seamless check-in and check-out process – you’re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.
q: What It Takes to Make the Stay
At Hilton, Our Core Values Define What It Takes To Succeed Here And Guide The Qualities We Look For In Every Team Member

A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality. Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership. A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.
r: Deliver a warm welcome: Greet guests upon arrival and complete the check-in process, including verifying details, assigning rooms, issuing keys, and providing welcome materials or bell service assistance
Support efficient check-out: Process guest departures by verifying charges, handling payments, issuing receipts, and using the point-of-sale system accurately
Provide hotel and local knowledge: Demonstrate comprehensive knowledge of hotel offerings, room types, rates, promotions, and local area information to assist with guest inquiries
Promote hotel services: Use up-selling techniques to recommend hotel amenities and maximize room and service revenue
Delight our guests: Respond to guest requests, resolve concerns with care and urgency, and effectively manage messages and communications
x: At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality.

Our award-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. With our suite of world-class brands , and a company-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we’re setting new standards for the future of travel.

Whether you’re starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career—and help us make every stay a little more magical.
Curious about life at Hilton? Explore our Careers Blog to see why we’re more than a great place to stay—we’re a great place to work.

d: Nass MEP is looking for an experienced MEP Operations Manager to lead and coordinate the successful delivery of multiple mechanical, electrical, and plumbing projects across Bahrain, from preconstruction and planning through execution, testing, commissioning, and final handover.

The successful candidate will be responsible for ensuring projects are delivered safely, on time, within budget, and in accordance with contractual, technical, quality, and regulatory requirements. This role requires strong leadership, commercial awareness, technical knowledge, project management expertise, and the ability to effectively coordinate clients, main contractors, consultants, subcontractors, suppliers, and internal teams.
q: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent qualification in Mechanical Engineering or Electrical Engineering .
Minimum 15+ years of progressive experience in MEP project execution, construction, or related project operations.
Proven experience managing multiple MEP projects from planning and execution through testing, commissioning, and final handover.
Previous experience working in the GCC region , preferably with strong knowledge of the Bahrain construction environment.
Strong knowledge of MEP systems, project planning, budgeting, resource management, procurement, cost control, and project execution.
Strong understanding of MEP design standards, construction practices, testing and commissioning requirements, and applicable local regulations.
Demonstrated experience managing subcontractors, suppliers, and multidisciplinary engineering and site teams.
Strong understanding of quality, health, safety, and environmental requirements.
Proven ability to manage client, main contractor, consultant, subcontractor, and supplier relationships.
Excellent communication, coordination, leadership, stakeholder-management, and problem-solving skills.
Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities while delivering against challenging schedules, budgets, and contractual requirements.
Strong reporting, commercial awareness, and decision-making capabilities.
PMP certification or relevant professional engineering license is an advantage.
r: Oversee the full lifecycle of multiple MEP projects, ensuring compliance with approved schedules, specifications, budgets, contractual requirements, and quality standards.
Lead coordination with clients, main contractors, consultants, and other key stakeholders to ensure smooth project execution.
Prepare and manage detailed project plans, scopes of work, timelines, milestones, resource requirements, and project schedules.
Develop and manage project budgets, monitor expenditures, and implement effective cost-control measures to support profitable project delivery.
Support preconstruction and work-winning activities, including project inputs, estimates, planning assumptions, technical coordination, and project execution strategies.
Coordinate the procurement of MEP materials, equipment, and services in collaboration with the Supply Chain and Procurement teams.
Plan and optimize the allocation and utilization of manpower, materials, plant, machinery, equipment, and other project resources.
Supervise Project Managers, engineers, site teams, and cross-disciplinary leads to ensure effective and timely project execution.
Manage and coordinate subcontractors, suppliers, and third-party vendors to ensure works are completed safely, efficiently, and in accordance with project requirements.
Review technical specifications, shop drawings, BOQs, equipment data sheets, method statements, material submissions, and other MEP-related documentation.
Oversee MEP testing, commissioning, documentation, close-out activities, and final project handover.
Monitor project progress and identify potential delays, cost overruns, resource constraints, technical issues, and operational risks, ensuring timely corrective action.
Prepare and submit regular project progress, cost, performance, and management reports, highlighting key risks, delays, corrective actions, and decisions required.
Ensure compliance with applicable Bahraini regulatory requirements, contractual obligations, technical standards, quality requirements, and HSSE procedures .
Develop and implement effective quality-control measures to ensure MEP works meet approved specifications and applicable standards.
Maintain effective communication and coordination with internal and external stakeholders throughout the project lifecycle.
Monitor the effective utilization of plant, machinery, manpower, materials, and subcontractor resources and prevent unnecessary expenditure or misuse.
Support the timely resolution of technical, commercial, procurement, and operational issues affecting project delivery.
Ensure projects are completed within agreed timelines, approved budgets, and required contractual and regulatory standards.
Perform other duties and assignments as directed by the MEP Division Manager in line with business requirements.

d: Designfit is a design and interior fit-out company coordinating design, procurement, and project delivery for commercial spaces. Working in the construction sector, the company delivers commercial interiors through close collaboration across design, supply, and site execution teams.

This Project Manager role is central to the successful delivery of interior fit-out projects, bringing structure, oversight, and momentum across the full project lifecycle. You will work closely with clients and project stakeholders to keep delivery aligned with project goals, quality expectations, timelines, and budgets.
q: Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Management, Architecture, or a related field.
A Master’s degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Management, Architecture, or a related field is considered an advantage.
PMP, LEED, or NEBOSH certification is considered an advantage.
10–15 years of relevant interior fit-out experience, including at least three years in project management overseeing complete project lifecycles.
Experience delivering high-end commercial, retail, food and beverage, hospitality, or corporate office projects on time, within budget, and to quality standards.
Proven ability to lead cross-functional project teams, coordinate with clients, consultants, and subcontractors, and manage multiple projects simultaneously.
Local authority regulations and approval processes, including DM, DCD, and Trakhees
Experience working on projects in the UAE and familiarity with regional construction practices are highly preferred.
r: Lead and manage all phases of the interior fit-out project lifecycle, including design coordination, procurement, construction, testing, commissioning, and final handover.
Develop detailed project programs and deliver milestones on schedule and within budget.
Coordinate clients, consultants, designers, suppliers, and subcontractors around project goals.
Review drawings, specifications, material submittals, and method statements.
Conduct site inspections to monitor progress, quality, and health and safety compliance.
Manage procurement schedules and delivery of long-lead items.
Prepare project reports, meeting minutes, and progress documentation.
Track cost control, change orders, cash flow forecasts, and other project financials.
Lead snagging and handover with relevant stakeholders.
Undertake other duties assigned by management in line with organizational needs.
